notes: Eclipse Loop 1.5.6 Arranger - Free-scroll during playback no longer fights you — the timeline stays where you put it and only follows the playhead again when you restart playback. - The TRIM tool now works across the whole clip: grab anywhere and drag the nearest edge. Drag the left edge to trim from the front (the right edge stays put) or the right edge to lengthen/shorten. Audio clips auto-loop when stretched past their natural length. Bounce - Fixed off-beat bounces — the bounced song now matches the arranger exactly (loop clips are tiled to their section length, with correct pitch, gain and pan). - Bounce now asks for a sample rate (44.1 / 48 / 88.2 / 96 kHz) and bit depth (16 / 24-bit) before exporting. Transport - Spacebar now stops song playback instead of restarting it from the top. Projects - File → Save now re-saves the open project directly (no more Save As every time). - Your SEQ setup is remembered: pattern length (1/2/4/8 bars) and SEQ vs. piano-roll view now save and restore with the project. - Double-clicking a project file opens it in Eclipse Loop, even when the app is already running. Windows - Mixer and Arranger open as floating windows by default — Option-click their buttons to dock them at the bottom instead.
